statement.zh: 测绘与综合将特奥蒂瓦坎表述为墨西哥盆地经典期规划大都会，仪礼核心与密集居住区已被系统调查（Millon TMP；Cowgill 2015；UNESCO 414）。
statement.en: Mapping and synthesis frame Teotihuacan as a planned Classic metropolis in the Basin of Mexico, with ceremonial core and dense housing systematically surveyed (Millon TMP; Cowgill 2015; UNESCO 414).
